title: Every mode on a site whose quickstart release has a where-map (sealed, bound, EmDash Tracy Business) ends its 'Where visible text lives' line with the where-map pointer: content.read {describe:true}'s where.<topic> for a form, page, menu, the design or SEO, and how to turn it off and back on, before any CMS, plugin or template source; a site whose release has none gets no pointer (since PR #1071)
steps: S1: No stand, no browser, no model. Work in the TCH checkout at the commit under test, with its dependencies installed (pnpm install) and the deepseek-harness submodule initialised.
S2: From the checkout root run: node --test packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/site-context.test.mjs — keep its last 12 lines and its exit code.
S3: Run: node --test --test-name-pattern='where-map:|size:' packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/site-context.test.mjs — keep the 'ok'/'not ok' lines and its exit code.
S4: Run: grep -c 'WHERE_MAP_POINTER' packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/lib/index.js — keep the number.
S5: Read the 'ℹ pass' and 'ℹ fail' lines of S2 and S3. A command that cannot start (missing module) is BLOCKED, not FAIL.
expect: S3: no 'not ok', at least 16 'ok' (26 on 10/10/2026: PR #1071 also added ten 'where-map:' tests on which release a folder names). Each of the eleven 'where-map: every mode is pointed at the quickstart's where-map, only on a site whose release has one: <row>' tests is 'ok' once: the four rows whose release has a where-map (wm-jsealed, wm-wprecord, wm-wpbound, wm-emdash) carry the pointer in designer, developer, writer and seo-geo, and the seven without one (wm-joomla, wm-jbase, wm-jderived, wm-wp, wm-wpbase, wm-emdash-open, wm-emdash-base) carry none in any mode (rule changed by PR #1071; before it every row had the pointer). The five 'size:' budgets are 'ok'. Before the fix (PR #926) no row carried the pointer.
S4: 2 (the constant and the row that ends with it): the committed lib/index.js carries the change (RULE #3: the image copies lib/ as it is).

selectors.pointer: packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/src/host/site-context.mjs WHERE_MAP_POINTER, appended to the '- Where visible text lives:' line

evidence: Flow D of the Apply audit, 05/10/2026 (55 runs on benchwpapply02, benchemdashapply01, benchjoomlaapply01): 6 runs read content.read {describe:true}; 43 calls read CMS or plugin source; the contact form toggle read source for 8-23 steps on all three platforms before its one write. The pointer adds 217 characters to every mode's site context (measured on all five platform rows x four modes).
fence: Mechanism only: what the site context says, in every mode and on every row. Not covered: whether the model then reads the describe before hunting (a bench measure, flaky by nature).
